column3: The active handing over is rendered passively.
The difficulty of reaching Cnidus is not expressed.
Ship and cargo reverse the order.
The comparative “more than” is replaced by “contrary to.”
“Ropes” specifies the helps; “sea anchor” specifies the gear.
“The lives of” is supplied before those sailing with Paul.
The speaker of the message is explicitly identified as God.
The sailors approach land rather than land approaching them.
